hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric of Texas Roadhouse's growth model, reflecting its expansion in the casual dining segment with three distinct concepts operating across 49 states and 10 countries

kpis.name: Total restaurant count
kpis.explanation: Total number of restaurants operated and franchised by the company
kpis.description: The company operates 816 restaurants across three concepts (Texas Roadhouse, Bubba's 33 and Jaggers) throughout 49 states, 1 US territory and 10 countries

kpis.name: Company-operated restaurants
kpis.explanation: Number of restaurants fully owned and operated by the company
kpis.description: Texas Roadhouse owns and operates 714 restaurants as of December 30, 2025, comprising 648 Texas Roadhouse, 56 Bubba's 33 and 10 Jaggers

kpis.name: Franchised restaurants
kpis.explanation: Number of restaurants operated by franchisees under the company's brands
kpis.description: Texas Roadhouse franchises 102 restaurants, including 36 domestic Texas Roadhouse, 5 domestic Jaggers, 60 international Texas Roadhouse and 1 international Jaggers

risks.title: Slow growth
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on expansion to maintain growth, but factors such as competition for prime locations, construction costs and delays in opening new restaurants may negatively impact results.

risks.title: Cost inflation
risks.score_rationale: Cost inflation, particularly in food commodities, can significantly impact the company's results, as it may lead to increased costs without the ability to raise menu prices.

risks.title: Reputational risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's reputation is critical to its success, and any negative incident, such as a food safety crisis or scandal, could have serious consequences for its business.

risks.title: Supply chain dependence
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its suppliers for food commodities, and any issues with these suppliers could negatively impact its results.

risks.title: International expansion risks
risks.score_rationale: The company's expansion into international markets presents additional economic, political and regulatory risks that could negatively impact its results.

risks.title: Geographic concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company's concentration in certain states, such as Texas and Florida, makes it vulnerable to economic trends and negative events in those regions.

risks.title: Competition risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive environment, and competition could negatively impact its results, particularly if competitors offer more attractive menus or lower prices.

risks.title: Acquisition risks
risks.score_rationale: Acquisitions of existing restaurants or new brands may present risks, such as high integration costs, corporate culture issues and challenges in managing new brands.

ai_positioning.summary: Texas Roadhouse has not mentioned artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
